newsitem.title: ESTONIA: NEW MORTGAGE AGENCY TO BE RUNNING BY YEAR-END.
newsitem.headline: NEW MORTGAGE AGENCY TO BE RUNNING BY YEAR-END.

text.p: The first mortgage agency in central and eastern Europe is now awaiting the creation of its legal structure before it seeks capitalisation of $20-$30 million, the chairman of the company setting up the agency said.

The aim of the agency is take over mortgages from Estonian banks and convert them into tradeable securites. It has the support of the larger banks in Estonia, who will also become the company's share holders.
"Clearly we are breaking new ground and this has not been down anywhere in central and eastern Europe before," Joachim Helenius, chairman of Hansa Investments, told Reuters.
He said the final details of the agency's structure were still being finalised by international experts.
"We are aiming to do it (the creation of the legal enitity) before the summer, but with something as complex as this, timing needs to be taken with a pinch of salt, he added.
After the legal formation of the agency, it will be capitalised with 20-30 million dollars and be in operation by the end of the year, Helenius said.
"When the agency is set up is to have as its share holders the leading banks in Estonia, international institutions and private sector institutions," Helenius said.
While the company is still in the process of foundation it is already looking beyond Estonia's borders.
"If we can create the right sort of structure that works very well then the model will have been created and it can be replicated in other countries," Helenius said.
However, Helenius said that any decision to expand would have to be taken by the new agency's share holders.
